title: The group construction for R(T_k) ≤ 2^{3k−1} in Pratt's arXiv:2311.02774v1: the printed map and a corrected one
statement: Let T_k = Σ x_S y_T z_U over all k-subsets S, T, U of [3k] with S ∪ T ∪ U = [3k] (Pratt, arXiv:2311.02774v1, Definition 1.4). For G = Z_2^m, a map f from k-subsets to G and x ∈ G, call (f, x) valid if f(S)+f(T)+f(U) = x holds exactly for the ordered partitions (S, T, U). (1) For every f and x, Σ_{y∈Z_2^m} (−1)^{y·x} u_y⊗u_y⊗u_y = 2^m H_f with u_y(S) = (−1)^{y·f(S)} and H_f the 0/1 tensor of the triples with f(S)+f(T)+f(U) = x; so a valid pair gives R(T_k) ≤ 2^m in characteristic ≠ 2. (2) G = Z_2^{3k}, f(S) = 1_S, x = all-ones is valid for every k. (3) The deletion map f(S) = 1_{S∖{1}} ∈ Z_2^{[3k]∖{1}}, x = all-ones, is valid for every k ≥ 1; hence R(T_k) ≤ 2^{3k−1} over every field of characteristic ≠ 2, as stated in item 4 after Corollary 1.12 of v1. (4) The improved map printed there (f(S) = Σ_{s∈S} e_s if 1 ∈ S, else 1^{3k−1} + Σ_{s∈S} e_s, x = all-ones, in Z_2^{3k−1}) is, when the element 1 has no coordinate (e_1 = 0), valid exactly for odd k; for even k its false positives are the ordered triples (A∪B, A∪C, B∪C) with A, B, C pairwise disjoint (k/2)-sets, (3k)!/((k/2)!^3 (3k/2)!) of them (120 for k = 2, 83160 for k = 4; 20 and 13860 unordered), e.g. ({1,2},{1,3},{2,3}). Read with another element missing (e_m = 0), or with the missing symbol read as the all-ones vector, it is valid for no k.

bases: Pratt 2023, arXiv:2311.02774v1, §1.2, item 4 of the comments after Corollary 1.12 (the bound 8^k/2 and its group construction)

sources.title: A stronger connection between the asymptotic rank conjecture and the set cover conjecture
sources.note: Base of the note. Version v1 read in full; §1.2, item 4 after Corollary 1.12 is quoted in the README (symbols retyped from the PDF text), Definition 1.4 defines T_k. The note proves which statements of that item hold: the bound, the principle and the first instantiation; and for which k the printed improved map is valid under each reading.

Proposition 6.18 (p. 31; 6.17 in v1) bounds R(T_k) by ½ 8^k − Σ_{i=k+1}^{⌊3k/2⌋} C(3k,2i) over algebraically closed fields of characteristic 0, which implies R(T_k) ≤ 2^{3k−1} there; they cite Pratt's bound (p. 31) and do not discuss his construction.
